sentences.text:
Smt. Nirmala Devi And Others vs . Sh. Ramesh Chand And on 9
May, 2024
Author: Sandeep Sharma

Bench: Sandeep Sharma
Smt. Nirmala Devi and others vs. Sh. Ramesh Chand and others .
Cmp No.6328 of 2024 in Fao No.84 of 2017 09.05.2024 Present Mr. Sanjay Bhardwaj, Advocate,
for the applicants/ appellants.
Mr. Jagdish Thakur, Advocate, for the non- applicant/respondent.
By way of instant application, prayer has been made on behalf of applicants/appellants for release of the amount lying deposited in the Registry of this Court.
No reply is intended to be filed on behalf of the non-applicant/ respondent.

Learned counsel representing the non- applicant/respondent fairly states that on account of judgment dated 13.03.2024 passed by this Court in FAO(MVA) No.84 of 2017, amount lying deposited in the Registry of this Court, deserves to be released in favour of the applicants/appellants.

Having perused the averments contained in the application, which is duly supported by an affidavit as well as other material available on record, this Court finds that appeal bearing FAO(MVA) No.84 of 2017, having been filed by the applicants/appellants, stands partly allowed vide judgment dated 13.03.2024, whereby amount awarded by learned Tribunal below has been enhanced.

Since enhanced amount in terms of aforesaid judgment has been already deposited by the non-applicant/ respondent-Insurance Company and aforesaid judgment has been not laid challenge in the superior Court of law, .
prayer made in the instant petition deserves to be allowed.

Consequently, in view of the above, the present application is allowed and Registry is directed to r e l e a s e t h e e n h a n c e d a m o u n t o f c o m p e n s a t i o n d e p o s i t e d b y t h e non-applicant/respondent/insurance company alongwith up to date interest, falling in the shares of applicants/appellants in equal shares, by remitting the same in their saving bank accounts, details whereof are given in para-4 of the application,
subject to the verification by the Accounts Branch
